places.name: Durgiana Temple
places.ai_summary: A prominent Hindu temple in Amritsar, resembling the Golden Temple in its architectural style.

opening_hours.notes: Photography is allowed.

places.place_tip: Visit the temple shop for religious souvenirs.

attribution.title: Many of the locals we had spoken to were delighted that the Govt has sanctioned funds for renovation of this temple (38049489065)
attribution.author: shankar s. from Dubai, united arab emirates
attribution.description: While walking around the lake, I had missed this view- the beautiful half gold plated Durgiana Hindu temple framed between two fountains in the sarovar (lake) surrounding it. My brother had captured the view, and I was challenging myself to do the same as I had sometimes missed it. Well, success at last, on the way back! Many of the locals we had spoke to were delighted that the Govt has sanctioned funds for renovation of this temple Detailed notes about the Durgiana Hindu temple appear earlier in this album.(see previous pictures).  (Amritsar, Punjab, northern India, Nov. 2017)
